We Bring Your

Vision To Life

Welcome to ACL Remodeling LLC, where we turn houses into dream homes with quality craftsmanship and expert care.

​

Your home is more than just a place to live, it’s where memories are made. That’s why we’re passionate about bringing your vision to life with remodeling solutions tailored to your style and needs. Whether you’re updating a kitchen, transforming a bathroom, or reimagining your entire space, our team is here to make the process smooth, stress-free, and inspiring.

​

Proudly serving the Daytona Beach community, we’re committed to delivering exceptional results and a seamless remodeling experience. Let’s build something amazing together!

OUR SERVICES

We offer a diverse range of services to cater to your unique needs, including kitchen and bathroom improvements, custom closets outdoor kitchens, outdoor deck flooring, painting, and more. Our focus is on providing personalized solutions tailored to your preferences. From the initial consultation to the final walkthrough, we work closely with you, ensuring every detail is taken care of.

ACCOUNTABILITY

Time is of the essence, and at ACL Remodeling, we are committed to delivering projects on time and within budget. Utilizing only the best materials and equipment, we guarantee results of the highest quality. Our team is not just about completing projects; we're dedicated to exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships with our clients.

What Is an Advanced Polymer Shower?

An advanced polymer shower is built using non-porous, seamless panels designed to resist moisture, reduce buildup, and simplify daily cleaning. Unlike tile showers, advanced polymer does not rely on grout lines, which are often the source of staining, cracking, and mold issues over time.

advanced polymer showers are commonly used in:

Tub-to-shower conversions

Walk-in shower installations

Because of its performance and reliability, advanced polymer has become a preferred material for homeowners who want a shower that looks good and stays easy to maintain.

Something won’t go as planned

The cost will be higher than you expected

It will be messy

With tradesmen coming and going, it will feel a bit chaotic 

These are exactly the kinds of things we take seriously. And this is how: 

by providing active project updates during projects

by placing transparent pricing on our website and giving comprehensive proposals

by setting up dust mitigation and conducting post-project cleanup

and by sending daily updates telling you who will be coming to you house and when

When you hire Larson Basement & Bath, you’re getting a team of licensed and insured trade professionals that care not only about the end result, but also about your experience along the way.

We are Luke and Kristen Larson, the founders of Larson Basement & Bath. We started this company in 2021 out of a love for home renovations and a desire to see the industry changed for the better.

Our Values

We value four things above all else: clear communication, quality work, a singular focus, and cleanliness. These four priorities are what have over and over again prompted our clients to leave us 5 star reviews. 

Communication: We know how fun it is to “break ground” on your remodel! But we also know it’s not necessarily exciting to have part of your home torn apart, or to have people you don’t know working in your space. We make sure you know the team that will be working in your home, and when they will be there each day. We are readily available by email or text throughout your entire project to address any questions or concerns. We strive to make sure you’re never left wondering, “What happens next?”

Quality Work: You’ve heard the horror stories: a contractor started work, only to leave it unfinished for 6mo. Or worse, they ghosted their client completely. This is something we never do. We lay out a clear path to completion for your project so you can count on it being done on time. We don’t plan our projects haphazardly - we work intentionally with you and our team to make sure we have a schedule that works for you. 

A Singular Focus on Your Remodel: When it’s time to start your remodel, that is our focus until it’s done. Bouncing from job to job without finishing is unprofessional and a sign of an unorganized contractor who doesn’t respect your time or your home. We stay focused on your project from start to finish, because getting it done right and on time is what matters most.

Cleanliness: Though dust and debris are part of the process of remodeling, they don’t have to be a part of your home. We use things like dust barriers and air scrubbers to contain the dust particulates, and after the job is complete we bring in a professional cleaner. When we’re done, your new space will be live-in-ready.

We’ll be honest though. This one year warranty is legally required of all contractors in Minnesota.

We know life gets busy, and reaching out to your contractor about something small may not be on the top of your list. So, ten to eleven months after your project is finished we will reach out to set up a warranty visit. We will stop by and inspect the work to make sure it is holding up as it should. If anything isn’t holding up the way it is supposed to, we’ll take care of it for you.   

You get peace of mind knowing that you’re working with a team who cares enough to continue serving you well beyond the completion of your project.

Thank you for considering us!

We know you have a lot of options when looking for a team to complete your remodel. We hope you’ll give us a chance to turn your dreams into reality. We’re a team that cares, and we’d love to earn your business.

How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Minneapolis?
+

Bathroom remodel costs in Minneapolis vary by scope. An essential refresh starts around $12,000, most full remodels range from $20,000 to $45,000, and luxury or custom projects run $50,000 and up. Premium Bathrooms provides free in-home estimates with detailed, itemized proposals and no hidden fees — and financing is available as low as $106.00/month.

Do you offer free estimates?
+

Yes. We offer free in-home estimates with no obligation. We typically respond within 24 hours and come directly to your home to assess the space and put together a detailed proposal.

What areas do you serve?
+

We serve Minneapolis, Maple Grove, Plymouth, Ramsey, Eden Prairie, Brooklyn Park, Coon Rapids, Blaine, Otsego, Golden Valley, Anoka, Elk River, Champlin, Saint Paul, Minnetonka, Rogers, and all surrounding areas within 20 miles of Maple Grove, MN.

Do you offer a warranty on bathroom remodels?
+

Yes. Every project is backed by a 10-year craftsmanship warranty. If something isn't right, we own it and make it right — that's our commitment to every homeowner we work with.

How long does a bathroom remodel take?
+

Most bathroom remodels take between 1 and 3 weeks depending on the scope. We keep homeowners informed at every step and minimize disruption throughout the process.

Are you licensed and insured?
+

Yes. Premium Bathrooms is fully licensed and insured in the state of Minnesota (residential building contractor license BC768144). We carry liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage on every project, so you're protected from start to finish.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom remodel?
+

It depends on the scope of work. Cosmetic updates like replacing fixtures, vanities, or flooring typically don't require a permit. However, projects that involve moving plumbing, electrical work, or structural changes usually do. We handle the permitting process for you when required — you don't have to worry about it.

What does design build mean?

Simply put, design build means that we are at the drawing board coming up with concepts and ideas for your remodel and we’re hands on, boots on the ground completing the work we have designed. By having one company do design and construction, your remodel is simplified. Universal Design

Universal design is the design of products and environments to be usable by all people, to the greatest extent possible, without the need for adaptation or specialized design.

Universal design is related to aging-in-place remodeling and a Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS) can help you remodel your home using universal design concepts. The NAHB Remodelers in collaboration with Home Innovation Research Labs, NAHB 50+ Housing Council and AARP developed the CAPS program to address the growing number of consumers that will soon require these modifications. While most CAPS professionals are remodelers, an increasing number are general contractors, designers, architects, and health care consultants.

Frequently Asked Questions

Honest answers to what Pittsburgh homeowners ask us most.

How long has True Pittsburgh Remodeling been in business?

We've been serving Pittsburgh homeowners since 1987 — over 35 years of remodeling experience. We're a family-owned and operated company, and our reputation has been built through word-of-mouth referrals and satisfied customers across Pittsburgh and the surrounding communities.
 

What remodeling services do you offer?

We specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, and general contracting. Our services include ceramic tile and grout, flooring, lighting fixtures, plumbing repairs, hot water heater installation, cabinetry and carpentry. If you have a project in mind, give us a call and we'll let you know if it's something we can help with.
 

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. We are fully licensed and insured to perform remodeling work in Pennsylvania. This protects you as a homeowner throughout the entire project. We're happy to provide documentation upon request — just ask during your consultation.
 

What areas of Pittsburgh do you serve?

We serve homeowners throughout the greater Pittsburgh area including the South Hills, North Hills, East End, West End, and surrounding Allegheny County communities. Call us at 412-287-4536 and we'll confirm whether we cover your neighborhood.
 

Is the initial consultation really free?

Yes, completely free with no obligation. We visit your home, assess the space, and discuss your goals. You'll receive a detailed written estimate at no cost. There's no pressure to commit — we want you to feel confident before moving forward.
 

Will the final price match my quote?

Yes. Our written quote is what you pay. The only exception is if unexpected conditions are found during demolition — such as water damage or mold — or if you choose to change the scope. In either case, we always discuss it with you and get your approval before any additional work. There are never hidden fees.
 

Do you handle permits and inspections?

Yes. For projects that require permits — such as plumbing or structural changes — we handle the entire permit process on your behalf. We're familiar with Pittsburgh and Allegheny County requirements and make sure all work is completed to code. You don't have to coordinate with inspectors or chase down paperwork.
 

Can I supply my own materials or fixtures?

Yes, we're flexible. If you've already purchased tile, a vanity, cabinetry, or fixtures you love, we're happy to install them. We'll review the items beforehand to confirm compatibility. We can also source and supply everything if you'd prefer a fully managed experience — the choice is yours.
 

How do you keep my home clean during the project?

We use drop cloths, dust barriers, and protective floor coverings to contain the work area. Debris is removed regularly and we do a thorough cleanup at the end of every workday. We treat your home with the same respect we'd expect for our own.
